svg.title: Keychron C100 Symbol Pad Template
svg.desc: 10 by 10 Unicode symbol keyboard legend template, editable in Illustrator and Photoshop.
svg.text: Editable SVG template • 10×10 legend • imports into Illustrator and Photoshop
Tip: each key is an individual <g> group (key-r#-c#), so you can edit colors, outlines, or symbols per key in Illustrator/Photoshop.
Layout order matches the flashed firmware exactly: top-left to bottom-right, row by row.
